representation_model: Single Receipt -> Expense implication-style DFC constraint; no SELECT, EXISTS, or WHERE.

inventory.title: Entertainment, amusement, and recreation disallowance
inventory.anchor: Entertainment, amusement, recreation, or qualified transportation fringes
inventory.reason: The basic category disallowance is per-receipt, but executable correctness requires exception eligibility facts.

inventory.title: Club dues disallowance
inventory.anchor: Denial of deduction for club dues
inventory.reason: A receipt type and zero deduction are sufficient.

inventory.title: Qualified transportation fringe disallowance
inventory.reason: A qualified-fringe receipt classification is sufficient.

inventory.title: Annual per-recipient gift limitation
mandatory_modifiers: prior gifts to the same individual in the taxable year
inventory.reason: Exact enforcement requires cumulative annual per-recipient state, not only the current receipt.

inventory.title: Foreign travel business-allocation limitation
inventory.reason: Requires derived trip-duration and business-use allocation attributes.

inventory.title: Substantiation requirement
inventory.reason: A derived substantiation predicate can represent the evidentiary requirements.

inventory.title: Convention outside North American area limitation
inventory.reason: Requires derived location and business-purpose facts.

inventory.title: Cruise-ship convention limitation and annual cap
inventory.reason: The annual $2,000 cap requires state across multiple convention expenses.

inventory.title: Section 212 seminar and convention disallowance
inventory.reason: A receipt purpose/category predicate is sufficient.

inventory.title: Employee achievement award deduction limits
inventory.reason: Exact annual award aggregation cannot be enforced from a single receipt alone.

inventory.title: Business-meal eligibility requirements
inventory.reason: Requires meal-quality, presence, and exception eligibility attributes.

inventory.title: Employer-provided commuting transportation disallowance
inventory.reason: The base category is simple; exactness requires a safety-necessity predicate.

inventory.title: Luxury water transportation limitation
inventory.reason: Requires a derived trip per-diem ceiling and exception classification.

inventory.title: Travel as a form of education disallowance
inventory.reason: Travel purpose is sufficient for the prohibition.

inventory.title: Spouse, dependent, or accompanying-person travel limitation
inventory.anchor: Travel expenses of spouse, dependent, or others
mandatory_modifiers: expense otherwise deductible by accompanying person
inventory.reason: Requires relationship, employment, and purpose predicates.

inventory.title: Meal deduction percentage limitation
inventory.anchor: Only 50 percent of meal expenses allowed as deduction
inventory.reason: E.deduct can encode the percentage, but exactness requires exception and special-rate predicates.

inventory.title: Meals provided for employer convenience disallowance
inventory.anchor: Meals provided at convenience of employer
